sentences.text: 3. The Executive Engineer, Nalkoop Division-I, Varanasi has submitted instructions, according to which, Irrigation Department is not constructing the water tank but it is Jal Nigam.
It is also mentioned that the land, over which water tank is being constructed, is Gaon Sabha land.
4. It transpires from the record that the petitioner has already instituted a suit under Section 229B of UPZALR Act for declaration of his rights against Gaon Sabha and it is pending.

He has also applied for stay against Gaon Sabha and the said application is also pending, wherein he has also specifically prayed that the defendants in the suit should be restrained from changing the nature of the land or from handing it over to Jal Nigam and to maintain status quo.
5. Having regard to the aforesaid undisputed facts, we are not inclined to entertain the dispute in exercise of writ jurisdiction.
It is left open to the petitioner to pursue the pending suit or to avail such other remedy as may be advised.

(Kshitij Shailendra, J) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, A.C.J.) Order Date :- 12.1.2024 Ankit.
